calculation.expression: (-sum(pct_change(close), 3)) cross-sectionally demeaned, active only when lagged VIX daily return is above its trailing 60-day 75th percentile
calculation.description: At each completed date, identify a volatility shock using only the prior day's VIX return and trailing history. During shock dates, rank the negative three-day return as a cross-asset reversal signal; otherwise emit no signal.

validation.regime_notes: One-day IC/ICIR pass the benchmark gates on 107 shock dates with at least 8 valid instruments. The conditional sample is sparse and uncertainty is interpreted conservatively. Shock-date one-day IC was negative in 2020-2022 (-0.0362) but positive in 2023-2024 (+0.0933), 2025-2026 (+0.0824), and the available 2027 observations (+0.1138), indicating regime dependence. Positive five- and ten-day decay is supportive but not used for admission.
